project.name: Java Modules Showcases - branch index
project.description: Pointer to the branch holding the code for each article.

alwaysFail.message:
There is no code on this branch.
Every article in the series has its own branch, holding exactly the code that article describes. Pick the one for the article you are reading:
git checkout blog-1-basics Your First Modular Java Project with Apache Maven 4 git checkout blog-1-homework Solving Resource and Packaging Challenges git checkout blog-2-encapsulation Encapsulation - Hiding Implementation Details git checkout blog-3-api-impl Separating contract and implementation git checkout blog-4-services Services - inversion of control with ServiceLoader git checkout javapro-1 Modular Java Applications with Apache Maven 4 (JAVAPRO)
Then run the build again. README.adoc on this branch has the links.
The states differ in what they demonstrate, not in maturity, so there is no "newest" one to default to - which is why this branch builds nothing.
